usedFor: Calendly holds interview bookings and Recruitee holds candidates, so “Add a Note to Candidate” records each booking change.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” in Calendly, then “Add a Note to Candidate” in Recruitee
bestTemplate.why: One trigger covers scheduling, rescheduling and cancelling, so the candidate record keeps a trail of every change.

watchOut: “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” is polling, so notes land after a scheduled check.
